verdict.rationale: Kling documents image-to-video generation as a core capability, including start/end-frame image-to-video pricing and a claim that it gives 'every still image the narrative power of film.' However, no evidence states that the subject and composition of the source image are preserved in the motion output. The Elements identity feature covers consistency across shots, which is a different capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented fidelity to the source image's subject and composition, hands-on or independent corroboration of image-to-video results, and detailed image-to-video feature docs beyond pricing lines.

support.subject: As a creator, I can animate a still image into motion with the subject and composition preserved

citations.quote: Kling AI specializes in text-to-video, image-to-video, and text-to-image generation using diffusion transformer (DiT) architecture.
